description: This source file defines the HospitalTabScaffold widget, which provides a tabbed interface for hospital-related screens in the Flutter application. It manages navigation between the 'HospitalJobsScreen' and 'HospitalProfileScreen', including an app bar, bottom navigation bar, and conditional floating action button.

classes.name: HospitalTabScaffold
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that creates a tabbed interface for hospital-related screens, enabling navigation between job posts and profile views.

classes.name: _HospitalTabScaffoldState
classes.description: The state class managing the current tab index and building the scaffold with app bar, navigation, and conditionally showing a floating action button.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HospitalTabScaffold widget.
